stories.name: collapse-knownevents-freshest-per-slot
stories.description: Fix the latent stale-KeyPackage bug in syncKnownKeyPackages: before iterating knownEvents, build an intermediate Map<slot, NostrEvent> keyed by getKeyPackageIdentifier(event) ?? event.id, retaining only the event with the highest created_at per slot. Iterate this collapsed map instead of the raw knownEvents map. Wrap the collapse block in a code comment explaining the rotation-race root cause and the marmot-ts grace-window relationship.

stories.name: e2e-sibling-auto-invite-rotation-test
stories.description: Add a new Playwright e2e regression test at e2e/tests/sibling-auto-invite-rotation-race.spec.ts that reproduces the stale-KP failure mode: sign in two browser contexts with the same bunker URL using authenticate() with distinct slot strings, create Group A and wait for it to appear in the sibling's sidebar (confirming the first auto-invite works), then create Group B and assert it appears in the sibling's sidebar within 60 seconds. The test must fail on master HEAD before the fix and pass after.
